digest.component_or_area: Jira DC outbound sync – parent field handling
propositions: test_outbound_clear_parent_round_trips permanently fails because it attempts to clear fields.parent on a sub-task, which Data Center rejects with HTTP 400; the Epic Link path is reachable for standard issues and should be used instead

The blocking unknown—whether {epic_link_field_id: None} actually clears on DC 8.17.1—is already answered by two green cells (test_outbound_epic_parent_round_trips_via_the_epic_link and test_inbound_clear_parent_round_trips) in live run 30951453979, proving the clear operation succeeds

Re-homing the cell to Epic Link requires priming the parent through a LOCAL rebar edit in a pass so that should_propagate_removal recognizes the reference as MANAGED; creating the issue Jira-side does not reliably establish rebar as the manager

The probe scripts and workflow are not on the critical path since the harness already answered the question, but the probe identified a latent readiness bug: serverInfo 200 is not a sufficient gate for Jira Software custom fields to be available
The cell passed green in live run 30964805133 after re-homing to Epic Link clear with rebar-primed parent, confirming the mechanism is reachable and the managed-ref analysis holds

The non-sub-task branch of set_parent lacks read-back verification unlike the sub-task branch, creating a latent bug where a failed write could report success; this is not currently masking failures but should be hardened separately
